statusDetail: Coverage-complete multimodal audit across six representative public templates and flows.

page.framework: Server-rendered PHP-style MPA with jQuery, Bootstrap 3 and custom scripts
page.notes: Public adult-media catalog with a geographic age-verification gate, search, taxonomy, gallery and account templates.

findings.summary: The fixed dark palette does not respond to the user’s color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Computed CSS inspection found no prefers-color-scheme rule or color-scheme declaration; light and dark emulation produced the same 65,208-byte screenshot.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark surface tokens.

findings.summary: Autoplay motion is not suppressed for reduced-motion users.
findings.evidence: The page probe found an autoplay video and no prefers-reduced-motion CSS; reduced-motion emulation did not alter the rendered state.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential autoplay and animation under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: The age-verification controls fail contrast requirements.
findings.evidence: axe found two serious contrast failures: the leave action is 2.92:1 and the RTA link is 2.84:1; no prefers-contrast or forced-colors styles were found.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise text contrast to at least WCAG AA and add forced-colors/prefers-contrast support.

findings.summary: Route and state changes are abrupt rather than spatially connected.
findings.evidence: CSS/DOM probes found no view-transition usage, while the site exposes many full-document gallery, taxonomy, search and account transitions.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for navigation where motion is allowed.

findings.summary: The fixed navigation does not adapt on long pages.
findings.evidence: The scroll video shows the same fixed navigation treatment across a 2,843px page; probes found no scroll-state styling or progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce or adapt persistent chrome as the user scrolls and expose location/progress on long listings.

findings.summary: Dropdown and overlay positioning relies on legacy custom/Bootstrap positioning.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try despite dropdown and overlay surfaces in the DOM.
findings.suggestedFix: Use anchored positioning with position-try fallbacks for invoker-attached overlays.

findings.summary: The age gate is a custom div dialog with manual state handling.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found a div role=dialog inside a custom micromodal wrapper and inline closeModal state logic rather than a native dialog; no platform close behavior was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native dialog with explicit controls and appropriate non-light-dismiss behavior for required age verification.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and target sizing are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: Computed focus samples found visible controls with outline-style none or 0px, and controls as small as 16x16 and 38x34; axe also found 22 unnamed links.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide :focus-visible indicators and at least 44x44 touch targets without relying on hover.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is slow and mobile layout shifts are severe.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 7.1s and performance 62; the mobile layout observer recorded CLS 0.538 across five shifts.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP resource, reduce render dependencies, and reserve late-content space.

findings.summary: Most images lack intrinsic dimensions, causing avoidable shifts.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 41 of 43 images without dimensions; Lighthouse unsized-images failed and the layout observer measured CLS 0.538.
findings.suggestedFix: Set width/height or aspect-ratio for every image and preserve placeholders during lazy loading.

findings.summary: The critical path contains excessive render-blocking and third-party delivery.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 100 requests and 1,208,727 transferred bytes; 16 stylesheets and numerous parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority styles were identified, with LCP at 5.05s in trace.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline critical CSS, defer non-critical styles/scripts, self-host essentials, and remove unnecessary dependencies.

findings.summary: Large amounts of shipped CSS and JavaScript are unused.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 203 KiB unused JavaScript and 30 KiB unused CSS; the page loads jQuery, jQuery UI, Bootstrap, Font Awesome and many page-wide bundles.
findings.suggestedFix: Split bundles by route and conditionally load download, picker, advertising and account code only where needed.

findings.summary: Many image links and search controls lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: axe found 21 missing image alternatives and 22 links without discernible names; probes found unlabeled search inputs across templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Add contextual alt text or presentation roles, label search inputs, and name icon-only links/buttons.

findings.summary: Key age-verification choices have insufficient contrast.
findings.evidence: axe measured the leave action at 2.92:1 and the RTA link at 2.84:1 against required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Use accessible foreground/surface tokens and test every interactive state to WCAG AA.

findings.summary: Heading, landmark, list, and focus structure is incomplete.
findings.evidence: axe found invalid heading order, malformed list structure and seven regions outside landmarks; computed focus inspection found several visible links with 0px outlines.
findings.suggestedFix: Use main/header/footer landmarks, sequential headings, valid lists, and robust :focus-visible styles.

findings.summary: Mobile zoom is disabled and several controls are undersized.
findings.evidence: The viewport contains user-scalable=no, which axe marks critical; focus probes measured 16x16 and 38x34 controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no, support 200–400% reflow, and enlarge interactive targets.

findings.summary: The page emits runtime and network errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse recorded ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR for a sprite and SyntaxError: Unexpected token < from /js/expp.js.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix asset origins and content types, and remove or repair the failing script.

findings.summary: Image sizing and document assets are not soundly declared.
findings.evidence: Although doctype and charset are valid, 41 of 43 images lack dimensions and Lighthouse failed unsized/responsive-image checks.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare intrinsic image dimensions and responsive sources while retaining the valid document metadata.

findings.summary: Deprecated third-party browser APIs and inspector issues are present.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported a deprecated Shared Storage API call plus cookie-related inspector issues from multiple advertising origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deprecated advertising code and resolve DevTools inspector issues before it breaks in future browsers.

findings.summary: Some links are not meaningfully crawlable and the viewport blocks zoom.
findings.evidence: The home probe counted 7 empty/# hrefs and 33 links without text; the viewport disables scaling, despite robots allowing search crawling.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every navigation anchor a real destination and descriptive name, and allow viewport scaling.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap signals conflict with the audited host.
findings.evidence: No canonical link is present, while /sitemap.xml returns URLs for imhentai.com rather than imhentai.xxx.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish self-consistent canonical URLs and a sitemap for the actual host, with redirects aligned to that canonical domain.

findings.summary: Pages lack structured data and social-preview metadata.
findings.evidence: Across home, gallery, tags, search and login, probes found no JSON-LD and no og:title, og:description or og:image.
findings.suggestedFix: Add content-accurate Open Graph metadata and suitable schema.org JSON-LD per template.

findings.summary: Important transport and content security headers are missing.
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but the headers primitive found no CSP or HSTS; two analytics cookies are not Secure and use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP and HSTS, then secure and scope all cookies appropriately.

findings.summary: The page exposes visitors to an unusually broad tracking and advertising footprint.
findings.evidence: The tracker primitive observed 25 third-party origins and Google tracking; Lighthouse found 15 third-party cookies, while HAR recorded 100 requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove opaque ad-tech chains, require explicit consent where applicable, and minimise analytics data and retention.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only and lacks modern credential support.
findings.evidence: The login template contains username/password fields with no autocomplete tokens or WebAuthn/passkey surface; no permission prompts fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey sign-in/registration and correct autocomplete tokens while keeping permissions contextual.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policy coverage is incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers inspection found no Permissions-Policy, CSP, or HSTS; Lighthouse reported 15 third-party cookies and cookie inspector issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Add Permissions-Policy, CSP/frame controls, HSTS and a plan to eliminate third-party cookies.

findings.summary: Runtime resilience is undermined by failing scripts and assets.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse recorded a SyntaxError and an SSL asset failure; HAR also captured aborted media, script and analytics requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Fail optional third parties independently, validate response content types, and keep core UI functional when dependencies fail.

findings.summary: The multilingual catalog is not bidirectionally or logically styled.
findings.evidence: Pages declare lang=en but no dir, and stylesheet inspection found no logical properties, despite Japanese and Korean catalog content and language routes.
findings.suggestedFix: Set language/direction per content and replace physical layout properties with logical equivalents.

findings.summary: Login and search fields omit autofill metadata.
findings.evidence: The login probe found username and password fields with empty autocomplete values, and search inputs have no explicit labels or autocomplete purpose.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=username and current-password, and label all fields clearly.

findings.summary: The account flow lacks passkeys and explicit credential assistance.
findings.evidence: The login form is password-only, omits username/current-password autocomplete, and depends on Turnstile; no WebAuthn option was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey authentication and retain a clearly explained, accessible fallback account flow.

findings.summary: Images are broadly unoptimised for device and viewport.
findings.evidence: Of 43 images, 31 use legacy formats, 21 lack srcset, 41 lack dimensions, 24 below-fold images lack lazy loading, and the age logo is 5x oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, responsive srcset/sizes, intrinsic dimensions and native lazy loading.

findings.summary: Background advertising and analytics perform substantial non-core work.
findings.evidence: HAR loaded 36 scripts and 25 third-party origins; the page also starts a muted autoplay video and Lighthouse identified 203 KiB unused JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove non-essential ad-tech, defer analytics, stop offscreen media, and conditionally load optional features.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts and autoplay media exceed a proportionate listing-page budget.
findings.evidence: The homepage transferred 1.21 MB over 100 requests, including 470 KB script, 460 KB images, 45 KB media and 25 third-party origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party/media budget, remove opaque chains and autoplay, and monitor transferred bytes per template.
